'''TK-710''' was the [[Operating number|designation]] of a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[stormtrooper]] who served the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. In the [[Standard year|year]] [[1 BBY]], he was stationed aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|first Death Star]] [[battle station]] when the [[YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' was pulled in by the station's [[tractor beam]]s. TK-710 and fellow stormtrooper [[TK-421]] were posted to guard the [[Light freighter|ship's]] [[Entry ramp|entrance]] in [[Docking Bay 327]] while a [[scanning crew]] checked the interior of the [[Freighter|vessel]]. The ''Falcon''{{'s}} crew ambushed the scanning crew and then impersonated them in order to lure TK-710 and TK-421 inside, incapacitating the stormtroopers and taking their [[Stormtrooper armor|armor]].

==Biography==
===Tricked aboard the ''Falcon''===
{{Quote|Hey, down there! Could you give us a hand with this?|Han Solo lures TK-710 and TK-421 onto the ''Millennium Falcon''|audio=Solo-HeyDownThere-ANH.flac|<ref name="ANH" />}}
TK-710 was the [[Operating number|designation]]<ref name="OMAM">{{StoryCite|story=Of MSE-6 and Men|book=From a Certain Point of View}}</ref> of an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[stormtrooper]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="ANH" /> In the [[Standard year|year]] [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas">{{FilmDate|IV|1|TK-710's service aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]]}}</ref> TK-710 served aboard the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|first Death Star]] [[battle station]]<ref name="ANH" /> with a security level of [[Zeta (security level)|Zeta]]<ref name="OMAM" /> while it was in the [[Alderaan system]] to [[Destruction of Alderaan|destroy]] the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]]-affiliated [[planet]] [[Alderaan]] as a display of Imperial might. Shortly after the planet's destruction,<ref name="ANH" /> the [[YT-1300 light freighter]]<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> known as the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' was pulled into [[Docking Bay 327]] aboard the [[Death Star]] by [[tractor beam]]s. After stormtroopers searched the [[Light freighter|freighter]],<ref name="ANH" /> [[Captain]] [[Edmos Khurgee]], [[Commanding officer|commander]] of the hangar, pulled back the remaining search teams and left TK-710 and [[TK-421]] as a minimal guard<ref name="Rise">{{EncyclopediaCite|The Rise of the Rebellion and the Battle of Yavin}}</ref> at the [[entry ramp]].<ref name="ANH" />

[[File:TK421ScanningCrew-ANH.png|thumb|right|300px|The stormtrooper TK-710 (right) stood guard outside the ''Millennium Falcon''.]]
A scanning crew was sent aboard with a large box of equipment to scan the entire vessel for lifeforms; however, before they could begin, they were ambushed<ref name="ANH" /> and [[stun]]ned<ref name="FilmNovel">''[[Un nouvel espoir - Le roman du film]]''</ref> by [[Chewbacca]] and [[Han Solo]],<ref name="Farmboy" /> creating a loud crash that the troopers did not investigate<ref name="ANH" /> as they assumed the scanning crew had dropped their box.<ref name="Paperback" /> Solo then impersonated one of the crew and called down to TK-710 and TK-421, asking them for help with the equipment. The two troopers glanced at each other,<ref name="ANH" /> but unaware of what had happened to the scanning crew,<ref name="Paperback" /> were unsurprised that the scanning crew needed help after dropping their equipment<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{EncyclopediaCite|The Rise of the Rebellion and the Battle of Yavin}}</ref> and made their way up the freighter's boarding ramp,<ref name="ANH" /> walking into a trap set by Solo and his ally [[Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="Geektionary">''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]''</ref>

Once the pair was on board, Chewbacca, Solo, and Skywalker jumped them.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> TK-710 and TK-421 were quick in reaching for their guns, but Solo outdrew them<ref name="Farmboy" /> and fired his blaster pistol twice.<ref name="Paperback">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: A New Hope'' junior novelization]]</ref> The struggle was brief,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and with no idea what had hit them,<ref name="Paperback" /> the incapacitated stormtroopers fell just as hard as the scanning crew.<ref name="Farmboy" /> Solo and Skywalker stripped the two troopers of their armor after Solo gave Skywalker the choice of which armor he wanted.<ref name="ANH" /> The troopers' unconscious bodies were stowed safely in the ''Falcon''{{'s}} smuggling compartments.<ref name="Odyssey">''[[The Odyssey of Star Wars: An Epic Poem]]''</ref>

===An impersonated Imperial===
[[File:Han_luke_stormarmor.png|thumb|left|300px|Han Solo used TK-710's armor as a disguise aboard the Death Star.]]
With the two troopers knocked out,<ref name="CD">[[A New Hope Read-Along Storybook and CD|''A New Hope'' Read-Along Storybook and CD]]</ref> Solo took TK-710's stormtrooper [[armor]] while Skywalker took TK-421's. Their disguises allowed the pair to sneak through the Death Star in a successful effort to [[Rescue of Princess Leia|rescue]] the [[Prisoner|imprisoned]] [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] of the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="ANH" />

The [[MSE-6 series repair droid|repair droid]] [[MSE-6-G735Y]] encountered the disguised pair during their journey through the Death Star and recognized the two troopers' armor, noting to itself that someone other than TK-421 was wearing his armor, but Chewbacca scared the [[Maintenance droid|droid]] away before it could act on the discovery. The Empire later became aware of what had happened to TK-710 and TK-421 after TK-421's corpse was discovered hidden in a crawl space.<ref name="OMAM" />

==Personality and traits==
TK-710 was a [[human]]<ref name="ECUC" /> male. Han Solo was impressed by how quickly TK-710 reached for his gun on board the ''Millennium Falcon'', although the trooper was still not fast enough to save himself. Upon donning TK-710's armor, Solo discovered that the [[helmet]] had an odor of bad breath, and he complained that it smelled as though the trooper had [[Sleep|slept]] in it.<ref name="Farmboy" />

==Equipment==
TK-710 wore stormtrooper armor and carried an [[E-11 medium blaster rifle]] and an [[N-20 Baradium-core thermal detonator]].<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Filming and name===
TK-710 first appeared in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. The character was played by an uncredited extra<ref name="ANH" /> in a scene filmed at some point between [[May 19]] and [[June 1]], [[1976]] on sound stage 3 at [[Elstree Studios]] in [[Wikipedia:Borehamwood|Borehamwood]], [[Wikipedia:England|England]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref> [[Stephen Bayley]], who played TK-421, has said that he never knew the name of the extra playing TK-710 but described him as an older gentleman whom he suspected had passed away by [[2016]].<ref name="EverythingGeekCast">{{YouTube|video=nugsoYXcPGw|text=Everything Geek Podcast Guest Interview- Stephen Bayley (London Film & Comic Con)|channel=channel/UCL-S0x-9XAx-OfAUIO23KTQ|name=Everything Geek Podcast|archivedate=20171112133620}}</ref>

The stormtrooper's [[canon]] designation was revealed as TK-710 by the short story "[[Of MSE-6 and Men]]," which was written by [[Glen Weldon]] as part of the anthology book ''[[From a Certain Point of View]]'',<ref name="OMAM" /> published on [[October 3]], [[2017]].<ref name="Release date">{{SW|url=news/jon-hamm-as-boba-fett-leads-an-all-star-cast-on-the-from-a-certain-point-of-view-audiobook-exclusive|text=''From a Certain Point of View'' Audiobook Exclusive - Jon Hamm (as Boba Fett!) Leads an All-Star Cast}}</ref> In the [[Star Wars (LINE Webtoon)|''Star Wars'' LINE Webtoon]], written by [[Hong Jac Ga]], which began publishing on [[April 10]], [[2015]],<ref name="Daum.net">{{WebCite|url=http://webtoon.daum.net/webtoon/view/starwars|text=Web comic on Daum.net|archivedate=20190808064807}}</ref> TK-710 is referred to as "TX-4120";<ref name="Webcomic">[[Star Wars (LINE Webtoon)|''Star Wars'' LINE Webtoon]]</ref> however, [[LucasBooks]] executive editor [[Jennifer Heddle]] has stated that the [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]] is ambiguously canon, so this article assumes that the designation used in ''From a Certain Point of View'' is correct.<ref name="Heddle">{{Twitter|jenniferheddle|status/604430151309365249|[[Jennifer Heddle]]|quote=It is approved but its canon status is grey area. We gave them leeway for cultural interpretation|archivefile=File:LINE_Webtoon_Tweet.png}}</ref>

For [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]], the character first appeared in the<ref name="novel">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref> [[November 12]], 1976<ref name="StarWars.com">{{SW|url=news/check-out-over-40-years-of-star-wars-a-new-hope-novelization-covers|text=Check Out Over 40 Years of ''Star Wars: A New Hope'' Novelization Covers}}</ref> [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] of ''A New Hope'' by [[Alan Dean Foster]].<ref name="novel" /> The stormtrooper eventually received the designation [[TK-422]] in Legends as part of the [[1998]] ''[[Special Edition Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=TK-422}}</ref> This designation was also used in canon in the English release of "[[The Rise of the Rebellion and the Battle of Yavin]]," an entry in [[De Agostini]]'s [[Star Wars Encyclopedia (series)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia'']]<ref name="RiseEnglish">{{EncyclopediaCite|The Rise of the Rebellion and the Battle of Yavin}} {{C|English version only}} {{C|English version only}}</ref> series that was originally released in Spanish on [[March 9]], [[2021]].<ref name="De Agostini Date">{{DeAgostini|lang=es|url=libros-comics/enciclopedia-star-wars|text=Star Wars Encyclopedia}}</ref> This article treats the narrative source "Of MSE-6 and Men" as accurate<ref name="OMAM" /> over the non-narrative "The Rise of the Rebellion and the Battle of Yavin."<ref name="RiseEnglish" />

===Continuity===
The [[February 10]], 2015<ref name="Disney">{{Disney|subdomain=books|url=book/star-wars-a-new-hope-read-along-storybook-and-cd|text=Star Wars: A New Hope Read-Along Storybook and CD}}</ref> [[A New Hope Read-Along Storybook and CD|''Episode IV: A New Hope Read-Along Storybook and CD'']] by [[Randy Thornton]] describes Solo, Skywalker and Chewbacca as knocking out guards and stealing their uniforms after agreeing to rescue Organa,<ref name="CD">[[A New Hope Read-Along Storybook and CD|''A New Hope'' Read-Along Storybook and CD]]</ref> contradicting the film.<ref name="ANH" /> ''[[The Skywalker Saga]]'', a [[2019]] adaptation of the films by [[Delilah S. Dawson]], describes Solo and Chewbacca knocking out two stormtroopers who come aboard the ''Falcon'' for inspection while the ship is seemingly empty,<ref name="Skywalker">''[[The Skywalker Saga]]''</ref> which also contradicts the film.<ref name="ANH" />

[[Jack Mitchell]]'s ''[[The Odyssey of Star Wars: An Epic Poem]]'',<ref name="Odyssey" /> released [[September 28]], 2021,<ref name="Abrams">{{Abrams|url=product/untitled-star-wars-novel_9781419756283|text=The Odyssey of Star Wars An Epic Poem}}</ref> states that Solo fires three shots at the troopers,<ref name="Odyssey" /> whereas the film has only two audible,<ref name="ANH" /> and then has Chewbacca strip them of their armor,<ref name="Odyssey" /> contradicting the description of Solo and Skywalker stripping the armor in ''[[A New Hope: The Princess, the Scoundrel, and the Farm Boy]]'',<ref name="Farmboy" /> a [[September 22]], 2015<ref name="Disney-Hardcover">{{Disney|subdomain=books|url=book/the-princess-the-scoundrel-and-the-farm-boy|text=The Princess, the Scoundrel, and the Farm Boy|nolive=1}}</ref> adaptation of ''A New Hope'' by [[Alexandra Bracken]].<ref name="Farmboy" /> Due to the extensive artistic license taken in adapting ''A New Hope'' for ''The Odyssey of Star Wars'',<ref name="Odyssey" /> this article assumes that the closer adaptation in ''The Princess, the Scoundrel, and the Farm Boy'' is accurate.<ref name="Farmboy" />

[[File:TheFollyOfTK421.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Chris Trevas's "The Folly of TK-421"]]
''[[The Adventures of Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight]]'', [[Tony DiTerlizzi]]'s [[2014]] adaptation of the original trilogy, states that the stormtroopers knocked out by Skywalker and Solo had remained on the ''Millennium Falcon'' after it was searched<ref name="Adventures">''[[The Adventures of Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight]]''</ref> rather than being called up by Solo as they are in the film.<ref name="ANH" /> Chris Trevas's illustration "The Folly of TK-421" shows one of the blaster bolts heard in ''A New Hope'' coming from the weapon of TK-421 while TK-710 is grabbed by Chewbacca;<ref name="Art">{{Facebook|username=trevasillustration|url=trevasillustration/photos/a.299141097330.153641.274376397330/10152636097117331/?type=3&theater|name=[[Chris Trevas]]|date=24-03-2015|quote=Many thanks to my models for The Folly of TK-421, Rebel Legion and 501st Legion members; Kieron Dillon, Tyler Tansel, Chris Blackstock and Cole Horton!|archivefile=File:Chris_Trevas_Folly_of_TK-421.png}}</ref> however, this contradicts<ref name="Farmboy" /> the [[May 4]], 2017,<ref name="Egmont New Hope paperback">{{Egmont|domain=co.uk|url=books/star-wars-a-new-hope-junior-novel/9781405285421|text=Star Wars: A New Hope Junior Novel}}</ref> [[Star Wars: A New Hope (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: A New Hope'' junior novelization]] by [[Ryder Windham]] and ''The Princess, the Scoundrel, and the Farm Boy'', both of which state Solo fired twice to take out the troopers. This article assumes the narrative sources to be correct.<ref name="Paperback" /><ref name="Farmboy" /> The LINE Webtoon depicts TK-421 and a second trooper referred to as TX-4120 searching the ship rather than standing guard, with Solo grabbing one of their legs from within a smuggling compartment before [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] activates his [[lightsaber]]. [[Pol Treidum's aide]] then attempts to contact both stormtroopers over comms and fails instead of Treidum seeing the disguised Skywalker.<ref name="Webcomic" />

===LEGO===
TK-710 appears in the [[2022]] non-canon [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'' in a cutscene adapting the events of the film. In the scene, he and TK-421 carry the scanning crew's crate on board the ''Falcon'' while Vader is still speaking with Khurgee. The officer reacts in shock while Vader remains oblivious to the sound of blaster fire from within the ship, followed by one of the troopers being thrown onto the boarding ramp before being dragged back inside by Chewbacca. Solo then begins to disembark in TK-710's armor, but is rapidly pulled back on board before Vader sees him. Still none the wiser, Vader leaves with a confused Khurgee.<ref name="LEGO">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]''</ref>
